title: What It Actually Looks Like to Lead Younger Men While God Is Still Building You
caption:
Most guys wait until they've got it all together before they invest in a younger man. That day doesn't come.

Go first in honesty, not answers. Bring him into your ordinary week. Point him past yourself, to a church, older men, and the Word. And stay under someone while you lead.

"What you have heard from me... entrust to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also." 2 Timothy 2:2

Tag the younger guy who's been watching you.

#faith #godlyman #mentorship #discipleship #christianmen
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
